newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian PM Fino welcomes foreign troops.
newsitem.headline: Albanian PM Fino welcomes foreign troops.

text.p: Albania's prime minister Bashkim Fino welcomed the arrival of multinational troops on Tuesday, saying their presence would help restore peace and order to the Balkan nation after months of violence.
"The government of Albania extends its best thanks in the name of the Albanian people for the readiness they have demonstrated in helping us at this delicate time," Fino said in a statement.

"We express our thanks in particular to Italy, as the leader of Operation Alba, and to the other participating states in this mission," he added as a force of 6,000 troops from eight countries was arriving in Albania on Tuesday.

"The presence and assistance of this force...will also have a positive impact in restoring peace and order," Fino said. "Its efforts will help in the reorganisation and training of the army and public order bodies."
More than 1,000 Italian, French and Spanish troops were arriving by air and sea on Tuesday to spearhead the force that will protect humanitarian aid supplies.

Nearly 300 people have been killed in near anarchy following the collapse of dubious get-rich-quick savings schemes. Tens of thousands of weapons fell into the hands of mafias and ordinary Albanians after raids on abandoned state armouries.

"The arrival of this force is in comformity with the will expressed by the Albanian state and its political parties," said Fino, whose all-party emergency government took office on March 14 and plans to organise early elections in June.
He expressed Albania's thanks to the United Nations, European Union, United States, and the Organisation of Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) for backing the mission.

"The arrival of the multinational force in Albania will play a significant role for the safe reception, escort and distribution of emergency humanitarian aid," Fino said. "They will safeguard ports, airports, communication junction points and other facilities related to the handling of relief aid."
Fino said the troops would help Albania "overcome the grave multifaceted crisis that has gripped our country."
"They are the bearers of the message of peace, friendship and solidarity," he said.
